title: Identifying WPA banjo players, trumpets and other members
summary: They name Landry, Andrew Morgan, Mike Lane on banjo, Sidney Cates, Leo Sanjay, Glapio, Crawford, Henry Russ, Louis the Man and McCullen, with Paul failing to recall some names.
